layout: Single screen, light bg (#F8FAFC). Content is vertically centered with consistent spacing. IDENTICAL LAYOUT to Step 1 and Step 3 — only the middle content changes.

layout_structure.top_bar: Ghost back arrow (top-left, active navy #003F8C), 'Skip for now' link (top-right, slate #94A3B8)
layout_structure.progress: Step indicator centered below top bar: 3 dot circles. Step 1: GREEN (#22C55E) filled. Step 2: ORANGE (#FF8A34) filled. Step 3: gray (#E2E8F0) outlined.
layout_structure.illustration: Large icon (map pin for Location) centered, ~80px, in blue (#003F8C)
layout_structure.heading: 'Where do you work out?' — navy (#0B1B3B), h2 (24px), bold, centered
layout_structure.subtitle: 'Cari lokasi gym favorit kamu' — slate (#64748B), body (16px), centered
layout_structure.content_area: Search input + popular chips + autocomplete area
layout_structure.cta: Button 'Lanjut' — orange (#FF8A34), full width, 14px/24px padding, 12px radius. ALWAYS ACTIVE (can skip).
layout_structure.spacing: 24px between each section. 16px horizontal padding on mobile, 32px on desktop.

elements: TOP BAR: Back arrow (ghost, navy #003F8C, active) left. 'Skip for now' link (slate #94A3B8, small 14px) right.
PROGRESS: 3 horizontal dots. Dot 1: green (#22C55E) filled circle. Dot 2: orange (#FF8A34) filled circle. Dot 3: gray (#E2E8F0) outlined circle.
ILLUSTRATION: Large map pin icon, centered, #003F8C, ~80x80px.
HEADING: 'Where do you work out?' centered, navy #0B1B3B, bold, 24px.
SUBTITLE: 'Cari lokasi gym favorit kamu' centered, slate #64748B, 16px.
SEARCH INPUT: Full width text input, 10px radius, 1.5px border #E2E8F0, 14px/16px padding. Left: search icon (#94A3B8). Placeholder: 'Cari nama apartemen, kampus, atau gym...'

POPULAR CHIPS: Horizontal row below input, 8px gap. 4 chips: 'Apartemen' (building icon), 'Kampus' (graduation icon), 'Kantor' (briefcase icon), 'Lainnya' (plus icon). Each pill 999px, bg #F1F5F9, text #64748B, 8px/16px padding. Tap to auto-fill search.
AUTOCOMPLETE: White card dropdown below search. Shows 3-4 matching locations. Each item: map pin icon + location name (bold) + address (small slate). Tap to select.
SELECTED STATE: Small card shows: green checkmark + 'Gym [Name] — [Address]' + 'Change' link in blue.
CTA: 'Lanjut' — orange (#FF8A34), full width, 14px/24px padding, 12px radius, shadow 0 4px 12px rgba(255,138,52,0.3). Always active (can proceed with or without location).
notes: IDENTICAL LAYOUT to 03a and 03c — top bar, progress dots, icon, heading, subtitle, CTA are all in same position. Only the content area between subtitle and CTA changes.
